_note: Official websites and boards/commissions pages for Washington counties and the largest cities. Each link was opened and checked in November 2026. 'appoints' marks a county with no boards page, where we link the commissioners who make appointments instead. 'meetings' is the county's own meetings or commissioners page, for counties whose calendar CivicsWA can't read yet. Added November 2026: more cities; each county's 'schools' (school districts, from OSPI's district directory) and 'districts' (educational service districts, ports, libraries, and public utility, transit and public hospital districts). Each address is the district's own website; where a site blocked automated checks we kept the official address and opened it by hand later.
